theme: Hedging without trading yourself to death
title: No-Trade Band: Rebalancing Without Bleeding Costs
strategies: static baseline: buy the initial delta-neutral hedge once and never rebalance again
continuous rebalancing: match the target delta exactly at every timestep regardless of gamma or cost
adaptive no-trade band: only rebalance once the tracking error leaves a band that widens with cost/gamma and narrows with gamma; when breached, move only to the band edge, not fully to target
lookahead/offline impulse control: exploit full knowledge of the price path to time trades against known future reversals
